turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on comparatives (-er, more ... than)?
turns.tutor:
Let me solve one first: "My brother is ___ (tall) than me."
I compare two people, so I change tall. Tall is a short word, so I add -er: taller. Then I use than.
Result: My brother is taller than me.
Rule: to compare two things with a short word, usually add -er and then use than.
Right: A mouse is smaller than a cat.
Wrong: A mouse is small than a cat.
Now you. Complete: "Cairo is ___ (big) than Luxor."
